#+bibliography: /nix/store/ykhk1fz6yg89ig20pp0cnnfmwkpr2994-org-texmacs-native-cite-end-to-end/references.bib
#+cite_export: texmacs-native plain
First [cite:@one] followed. Repeat /[cite:@one]/.

Multiple [cite:@two; @one].

#+print_bibliography:
After bibliography.
text-output:
<TeXmacs|2.1.5>

<style|generic>

<\body>
  First <with-bib|native-cite|<cite|one>> followed. Repeat
  <em|<with-bib|native-cite|<cite|one>>>.\ 

  Multiple <with-bib|native-cite|<cite|two|one>>.\ 

  <with-bib|native-cite|<\bib-list|2>
    <bibitem*|1><label|native-cite-one>Ada Alpha.
    <newblock><with|font-shape|italic|An <math|\<alpha\><rsub|i>> result>.
    <newblock>Press, 2026.<newblock>

    <bibitem*|2><label|native-cite-two>Zoe Zulu.
    <newblock><with|font-shape|italic|A <math|<frac|a|b>> result>.
    <newblock>Press, 2025.<newblock>
  </bib-list>>

  After bibliography.\ 
</body>

<\initial>
  <\collection>
    <associate|language|english>
  </collection>
</initial>
body: (document (concat "First " (with-bib #1="native-cite" (cite "one")) " " "followed. Repeat " (em (with-bib #1# (cite "one"))) ". ") (concat "Multiple " (with-bib #1# (cite "two" "one")) ". ") (with-bib "native-cite" (bib-list "2" (document (concat (bibitem* "1") (label "native-cite-one") "Ada Alpha. " (newblock) (with "font-shape" "italic" (concat "An " (math (concat "<alpha>" (rsub "i"))) " result")) ". " (newblock) "Press, 2026." (newblock)) (concat (bibitem* "2") (label "native-cite-two") "Zoe Zulu. " (newblock) (with "font-shape" "italic" (concat "A " (math (frac "a" "b")) " result")) ". " (newblock) "Press, 2025." (newblock))))) (concat "After bibliography. "))
